sys_ui_page.description: Server-rendered CMDB governance dashboard for the latest completed assessment run. Simple Jelly page backed by the CMDBGovDashboard script include.
sys_ui_page.html:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
  <!--
    CMDB Governance dashboard - classic server-rendered UI page.

    This file is deliberately tiny. It does two things:
      1. carries the stylesheet
      2. calls CMDBGovDashboard.render() once and prints the HTML

    All data loading, scoring and markup lives in the CMDBGovDashboard script
    include, so the page can be debugged without a browser:
        gs.info(new CMDBGovDashboard().render('overview'));

    Phase two (g2:evaluate plus the dollar-square output) is used because the
    dashboard is request dependent. Phase one output is cached and would serve
    stale scores.

    There is intentionally no inline script element anywhere in this file.
  -->
  <style type="text/css">.gov {
      font-family: "Lato", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      color: #10171a;
      background-color: #ffffff;
      padding: 16px;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .gov h1, .gov h2, .gov h3, .gov p, .gov ul {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .gov-h1 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .gov-h2 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 8px; }

    /* Score bands. Tint, edge and ink are always paired with a text label. */
    .gov-good { --gov-edge: #2e7d32; --gov-tint: #e8f5e2; --gov-ink: #123b10; }
    .gov-warn { --gov-edge: #a1660b; --gov-tint: #fdf3d7; --gov-ink: #3f2d06; }
    .gov-bad  { --gov-edge: #b3261e; --gov-tint: #fde4e6; --gov-ink: #41100d; }
    .gov-none { --gov-edge: #8b9499; --gov-tint: #f1f3f4; --gov-ink: #3c4448; }

    .gov-chip {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gov-edge, #8b9499);
      background-color: var(--gov-tint, #f1f3f4);
      color: var(--gov-ink, #3c4448);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* Header */
    .gov-head {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 16px;
      border: 1px solid #cfd5d7;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background-color: #fafbfb;
    }
    .gov-head-score {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      min-width: 150px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border-left: 5px solid var(--gov-edge, #8b9499);
      background-color: var(--gov-tint, #f1f3f4);
    }
    .gov-head-score-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #4b5559;
    }
    .gov-score-big {
      font-size: 40px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--gov-ink, #10171a);
    }
    .gov-facts { border-collapse: collapse; flex: 1 1 260px; }
    .gov-facts th, .gov-facts td {
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: top;
      padding: 3px 14px 3px 0;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .gov-facts th { color: #4b5559; font-weight: 400; white-space: nowrap; }
    .gov-facts td { font-weight: 600; }
    .gov-head-action { flex: 0 0 auto; }

    .gov-btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
      background-color: #00718f;
      border: 1px solid #005b73;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .gov-btn:hover { background-color: #004c61; }
    .gov-btn:focus { outline: 2px solid #0b7285; outline-offset: 2px; }

    /* Tabs: plain links, no client state */
    .gov-tabs {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      list-style: none;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-top: 22px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd5d7;
    }
    .gov-tab {
      display: block;
      padding: 9px 15px;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #10171a;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
    }
    .gov-tab:hover { background-color: #f1f3f4; }
    .gov-tab:focus { outline: 2px solid #0b7285; outline-offset: -2px; }
    .gov-tab-on { font-weight: 700; border-bottom-color: #00718f; }

    /* Pillar cards */
    .gov-cards {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      list-style: none;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .gov-cards li { flex: 1 1 180px; display: flex; }
    .gov-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: #10171a;
      border: 1px solid #cfd5d7;
      border-left: 5px solid var(--gov-edge, #8b9499);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background-color: #ffffff;
    }
    .gov-card:hover { background-color: #f6f7f8; }
    .gov-card:focus { outline: 2px solid #0b7285; outline-offset: 2px; }
    .gov-card-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #4b5559; }
    .gov-card-score { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; }

    /* Tables - each in its own scroll region so narrow screens scroll */
    .gov-scroll {
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid #cfd5d7;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background-color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .gov-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 480px; }
    .gov-table caption {
      caption-side: top;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #4b5559;
    }
    .gov-table th, .gov-table td {
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: top;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6e8;
    }
    .gov-table thead th {
      background-color: #f1f3f4;
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .gov-table-tight th, .gov-table-tight td { padding: 6px 10px; }
    .gov-num { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
    .gov-table td.gov-good, .gov-table td.gov-warn,
    .gov-table td.gov-bad, .gov-table td.gov-none {
      background-color: var(--gov-tint, #f1f3f4);
      color: var(--gov-ink, #10171a);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--gov-edge, #8b9499);
    }
    .gov-mono { font-family: "Courier New", monospace; font-size: 13px; }
    .gov-sub { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: #4b5559; font-weight: 400; }
    .gov-link { color: #00718f; text-decoration: underline; }
    .gov-link:focus { outline: 2px solid #0b7285; outline-offset: 2px; }

    /* Trend chart */
    .gov-svg { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 520px; height: auto; }
    .gov-legend {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      list-style: none;
      gap: 6px 18px;
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .gov-legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .gov-key { display: inline-block; width: 22px; height: 0; }
    .gov-details { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; }
    .gov-details summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 0; color: #00718f; }

    /* Pillar panel, metric tiles, check blocks */
    .gov-panel {
      padding: 16px;
      border: 1px solid #cfd5d7;
      border-left: 5px solid var(--gov-edge, #8b9499);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background-color: var(--gov-tint, #f1f3f4);
      margin-top: 14px;
    }
    .gov-desc { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 6px; max-width: 70ch; }

    .gov-tiles { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; list-style: none; gap: 12px; }
    .gov-tile {
      flex: 1 1 210px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
      padding: 13px;
      border: 1px solid #cfd5d7;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background-color: #ffffff;
    }
    .gov-tile-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
    .gov-tile-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }
    .gov-tile-na { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #4b5559; }

    .gov-check {
      padding: 14px;
      border: 1px solid #cfd5d7;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background-color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .gov-check-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .gov-problems {
      list-style: none;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #3c4448;
      background-color: #f1f3f4;
      border: 1px solid #dfe3e5;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .gov-problems li { padding: 2px 0; }
    .gov-rec {
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      background-color: #eef6f8;
      border-left: 4px solid #00718f;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* Dimming uses a darker grey on a light panel, never low opacity, so
       contrast stays readable. */
    .gov-dim { color: #3c4448; background-color: #f1f3f4; }

    .gov-notice {
      padding: 11px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .gov-notice-ok { background-color: #e8f5e2; border: 1px solid #2e7d32; color: #123b10; }
    .gov-notice-warn { background-color: #fdf3d7; border: 1px solid #a1660b; color: #3f2d06; }
    .gov-empty {
      padding: 14px;
      border: 1px dashed #cfd5d7;
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: #4b5559;
      background-color: #fafbfb;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .gov { padding: 10px; }
      .gov-score-big { font-size: 32px; }
      .gov-head { padding: 12px; }
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      .gov { color: #e7eaec; background-color: #161d21; }
      .gov-head, .gov-empty { background-color: #1d262b; border-color: #3b464c; }
      .gov-card, .gov-tile, .gov-check, .gov-scroll {
        background-color: #1d262b;
        border-color: #3b464c;
      }
      .gov-table thead th { background-color: #263036; }
      .gov-table th, .gov-table td { border-bottom-color: #313c42; }
      .gov-tabs { border-bottom-color: #3b464c; }
      .gov-tab { color: #e7eaec; }
      .gov-tab:hover { background-color: #263036; }
      .gov-card { color: #e7eaec; }
      .gov-card:hover { background-color: #263036; }
      .gov-facts th, .gov-sub, .gov-card-label, .gov-head-score-label { color: #aab3b8; }
      .gov-good { --gov-tint: #1b2e1b; --gov-ink: #cfe8c6; }
      .gov-warn { --gov-tint: #332a12; --gov-ink: #f0dca6; }
      .gov-bad  { --gov-tint: #351619; --gov-ink: #f5c2c6; }
      .gov-none { --gov-tint: #262f33; --gov-ink: #c3cbcf; }
      .gov-problems, .gov-dim { background-color: #263036; border-color: #3b464c; color: #c3cbcf; }
      .gov-rec { background-color: #16303a; }
      .gov-notice-ok { background-color: #1b2e1b; color: #cfe8c6; }
      .gov-notice-warn { background-color: #332a12; color: #f0dca6; }
      .gov-link, .gov-details summary { color: #6fc5dd; }
    }</style>
  <g2:evaluate var="jvar_gov_html" jelly="true">var govTab = 'overview';
    var govQueued = false;
    try {
      var requestedTab = RP.getParameterValue('tab');
      if (requestedTab) {
        govTab = '' + requestedTab;
      }
      var requestedQueued = RP.getParameterValue('queued');
      if (requestedQueued) {
        govQueued = ('' + requestedQueued) === '1';
      }
    } catch (govError) {
      govTab = 'overview';
    }
    new CMDBGovDashboard().render(govTab, govQueued);</g2:evaluate>
  <!--
    g:ui_form is the platform's own form tag. It supplies the POST action and a
    valid CSRF token, which is what routes a submit to this page's processing
    script. The dashboard's "Run assessment" control is a plain submit button
    inside this form carrying name=gov_action value=queue_run.

    Do not replace this with a hand-built form element: a nested form inside
    the platform frame is discarded by the browser and the button then does
    nothing when clicked.
  -->
  <g:ui_form>
    <g2:no_escape>$[jvar_gov_html]</g2:no_escape>
  </g:ui_form>
</j:jelly>
sys_ui_page.name: dash
